sentences: First a[0] becomes a[1] which is 7, and at the same moment a[1] becomes a[0] which was 4, so swapping.
Looking at the array, both assignments read the old values at once, so 4 and 7 trade places directly giving 7, 4.
Since a[0] gets 7 from a[1] and a[1] gets the original 4 from a[0], the two values just exchange positions.
The line a[0] = a[1] takes the 7, and together a[1] = a[0] takes the 4, so the array becomes 7, 4.
Both changes happen in one go, so position zero receives seven while position one receives four, swapping the numbers.
